title: The isolation boundary: a microVM per sandbox versus a shared kernel
design_ref: Choosing the isolation boundary (Tier 0 versus Tier 2)
purpose: Prove that a sandbox runs on its own kernel in its own virtual machine, by comparing it with a hardened ordinary container on a normal node.

steps.output:
NAME                          RUNTIME            NODE                  STARTED
python-untrusted-pool-9xp67   isolated-sandbox   i-0543f2a2608a827e3   2026-11-19T15:14:13Z

steps.display: orch exec sess-b606b111 "uname -r; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime"   # inside the SANDBOX
kubectl run tier0 --image=python:3.12-slim  # hardened ordinary container, Tier 0, on a normal node
kubectl exec tier0 -- sh -c "uname -r; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime"   # inside the ORDINARY CONTAINER
kubectl get node i-0ab84e37874257700 -o jsonpath='{.status.nodeInfo.kernelVersion}'   # the node's own kernel version

checks.description: the sandbox reports a virtual machine of its own (product name ends in .enclave)
checks.because: A Nitro Sandbox is a Firecracker microVM, and its firmware reports its own product name.

checks.description: the ordinary container reports the host machine, not a virtual machine of its own
checks.because: A normal container is a process group on the node and sees the node's hardware identity.

checks.description: the sandbox's kernel started when the pod started, not when the node did
checks.because: The sandbox boots its own kernel at pod start, so its uptime tracks the pod's age.

checks.description: the ordinary container's uptime tracks its node's age (it shares the node's kernel)
checks.because: A container shares the node's kernel, so /proc/uptime is the node's uptime.

checks.description: the ordinary container reports exactly the node's kernel version
checks.because: Same kernel: this is the shared-kernel risk the design's threat model describes (arrow 1).

notes: sandbox uptime 62s versus pod age 82s; ordinary container uptime 204s versus its node's age 196s
